# PulsingLabs

> PulsingLabs is a Pakistani health app for booking blood tests at home in Karachi. A phlebotomist from a licensed partner laboratory collects the sample at the patient's home, and results arrive in the app with plain-language explanations based on the patient's age and sex. Home collection is in Karachi only for now.

## Packages and prices (PKR, home visit included)

- Standard check-up, PKR 9,999, 17 tests: pulse, blood pressure (systolic and diastolic), haemoglobin, RBC, WBC, platelets, random blood sugar, the full cholesterol profile (total cholesterol, LDL, HDL, LDL/HDL ratio, triglycerides), TSH (thyroid screen), SGPT (ALT), creatinine, calcium.
- Premium check-up, PKR 19,999, 27 tests: everything in Standard (17) plus 10 more: HbA1c, ferritin, ESR, vitamin D, free T3, free T4, total bilirubin, urea, Anti-HCV and HBsAg (hepatitis C and B screening).
- Every test in both packages is non-fasting: patients eat and drink as usual.
- The packages are for all ages.

## How it works

1. Choose Standard or Premium in the PulsingLabs app, for yourself or a family member.
2. Add the address (map pin) and a phone number, then pick a day and time. Same-day visits need at least 5 hours' notice.
3. Pay in the app. The booking is made once payment succeeds; an invoice is sent by email and kept in the app.
4. PulsingLabs assigns a licensed partner lab. A phlebotomist visits, checks the visit code shown in the patient's app, takes pulse and blood pressure, and collects the sample.
5. The lab tests the sample and issues the results. They appear in the app on colour-coded charts for the patient's age and sex, and an AI assistant answers questions about them in English or Urdu.

## Changes and visiting charges

- Reschedule or cancel free up to 24 hours before the visit; cancelling then gives a full refund.
- In the last 24 hours the patient can't cancel or move the visit in the app; the lab calls them to arrange any change.
- If the visit has to move in those 24 hours because of the patient, or the patient is not home when the phlebotomist arrives, the first time is free; after that, visiting charges of 20% of what they paid apply.
- If PulsingLabs or the lab cancels, the patient gets a full refund.

## Also

- Family: parents, children and a spouse on one account; each gets their own Health ID and results.
- Privacy: results are private to the patient and never sold. For a company health programme, HR only sees who booked and completed a check-up, never results.
- Companies can ask about a team pilot through the contact page; there is no published corporate price.
- The AI explains results; it does not diagnose or prescribe, and it points urgent symptoms to emergency services.
